tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page ground behind every screen, POS and back-office. Text on it: ink, ink-muted.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Product tiles, cards, modals, inputs and table rows sitting on surface or surface-sunken. Text on it: ink, ink-muted.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells behind raised content: category rail, cart panel, keypad tray, table header. Text on it: ink, ink-muted.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines between rows, cards and panels. Never the only edge of a control; use border-strong for that.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Edges of inputs, checkboxes, outlined buttons and unselected tiles that must be seen. 3:1 or better on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken, accent-soft and the status soft fills.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (SKU, helper text, timestamps) on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken. Never placeholder-only labels.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Fixed BrewPoint identity, never recolored per shop: back-office side navigation, toasts, the offline banner. Text on it: on-brand.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The shop's accent (default Crema). Fills the primary button, the selected category and the quantity badge. Replaced at runtime by a shop's own color through deriveAccent. Text on it: on-accent.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and focus-visible fill of accent surfaces. Text on it: on-accent.

tokens.name: accent-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed fill of accent surfaces. Text on it: on-accent.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent, accent-hover and accent-pressed. Chosen per shop by deriveAccent (dark ink or white), whichever reaches 4.5:1.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected tile and selected row background. Text on it: ink, ink-muted.

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Accent-colored text, links, icons and the 2px selected-tile border on surface, surface-raised and accent-soft. 4.5:1 or better.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Synced, in stock, paid, active. Teal-blue on purpose so it stays apart from danger for red-green color blindness. Text and icon on surface, surface-raised and success-soft; always with a word or check icon.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background of success chips and banners. Text on it: success, ink.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Low stock, trial ending, needs attention. Text and icon on surface, surface-raised and warning-soft; always with a triangle icon and a word. Never a button fill.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background of warning chips and banners. Text on it: warning, ink.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, out of stock, voids, past due, the destructive button fill. Text and icon on surface, surface-raised and danger-soft; always with a word or icon. Text on the fill: on-danger.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a danger fill.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of danger chips and banners. Text on it: danger, ink.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Syncing, informational notes, license lease countdown. Text and icon on surface, surface-raised and info-soft.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Background of info chips and banners. Text on it: info, ink.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The 2px keyboard focus ring, drawn with a 2px surface-colored gap so it stays visible on accent, brand and every surface.

tokens.name: focus-inverse
tokens.usage: The keyboard focus ring for controls sitting on brand (side navigation, toasts), where focus would vanish.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind modals and the PIN prompt.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Receipt preview sheet. Always white in both themes, since it mirrors thermal paper. Text on it: paper-ink.

tokens.name: paper-ink
tokens.usage: Ink on paper. Receipts print in one ink with no color.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: First chart series (the current period, net sales). Deep crema so bars reach 3:1 on surface-raised; never the shop accent, which is too light for marks. Values and labels beside it stay in ink.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Second chart series in fixed order (plum). Validated beside chart-1 and chart-3 for red-green and blue-yellow color blindness.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Third chart series in fixed order (blue).

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Fourth chart series in fixed order (green). A fifth series folds into Other; never generate a hue.

tokens.name: chart-compare
tokens.usage: The comparison period (last week, same day last week), drawn as a dashed 2px line or an outlined bar. Neutral on purpose so the current period leads.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Chart gridlines and the baseline. Recessive; axis labels use ink-muted.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Sign-up and plan-choice headlines, empty states. Never inside the POS working screen.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Full-screen titles (open register, close register, plan choice).

styles.name: heading-md
styles.usage: Modal titles, panel titles, cart title, settings sections.

styles.name: heading-sm
styles.usage: Group titles inside a panel, category names in the rail.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Product names on tiles, cart line names, button labels on the POS.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Ask a manager to approve this discount.
styles.usage: Default running text and form input text.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Modifier lines, table cells, helper text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, chip text, table headers.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase group labels above sections. Set uppercase in the markup.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Timestamps and metadata only. Never the only place a required fact appears.

styles.name: amount-xl
styles.usage: Total due on the checkout screen. Tabular figures.

styles.name: amount-lg
styles.usage: Cart total, change due, session totals. Tabular figures.

styles.name: amount
styles.usage: Prices on tiles and cart lines, table money columns. Tabular figures, right-aligned in columns.

styles.name: key
styles.usage: Numpad keys for PIN and cash entry. Tabular figures.

styles.name: receipt
styles.usage: Receipt body. Plex Mono is 0.6em wide, so 9.4px gives 32 columns on 58mm paper and 48 on 80mm.

styles.name: receipt-strong
styles.usage: Receipt totals and the acknowledgment footer.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, chip inner padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls, tile grid gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inner padding of chips, banners and cart lines.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default card padding, page gutter on tablet.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Modal padding, gap between panels.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section spacing inside a panel, desktop gutter.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Spacing between page sections in back-office screens.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Empty-state and sign-up screen spacing.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, small tags, table cell focus.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, keypad keys, chips' non-pill variants.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Product tiles, cards, banners, receipt preview.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Modals and bottom sheets.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status chips and the sync indicator.

shadow.note: Warm-tinted shadows in Daylight; near-black in Night shift. Use sparingly: tiles use a border, only floating layers get a shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: Raised tiles when pressed states need depth, sticky headers.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Modals, popovers, toasts.

size.note: Touch and layout dimensions for a landscape tablet POS, with a denser desktop back-office.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Smallest tappable height anywhere (back-office desktop controls, chips that act as buttons).

tokens.name: target-pos
tokens.usage: Height of every button and input on the POS screens, and the minimum tile row height.

tokens.name: target-key
tokens.usage: Height of numpad keys and the Pay button. Quantity steppers use target-pos.

tokens.name: tile-min
tokens.usage: Minimum product tile width; the grid fits as many columns as this allows.

tokens.name: cart-width
tokens.usage: Width of the cart panel beside the product grid on a landscape tablet.

tokens.name: rail-width
tokens.usage: Width of the category rail.

tokens.name: sidenav-width
tokens.usage: Width of the back-office side navigation on desktop.

tokens.name: topbar-height
tokens.usage: Height of the POS top bar.

tokens.name: panel-width
tokens.usage: Width of the notification panel that drops from the bell in the back-office header.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky headers and the cart footer.

tokens.name: z-banner
tokens.usage: Offline, trial and license banners.

tokens.name: z-modal
tokens.usage: Modals, the PIN prompt and the scrim.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts, above everything.
